text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "Cheap models are often practically ineffective, since they release warm air into the room – and some models are also very noisy.", "severity": 0.2, "before": ""}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Les appareils bon marché sont le plus souvent presque totalement inefficaces, puisqu'ils rejettent de la chaleur dans la pièce tout en étant bruyants.", "severity": 0.2, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "airing rooms thoroughly in the morning, then keeping the windows closed.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Instead of buying such appliances, there are other simple ways of keeping cool during periods of hot weather: "}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "aérer massivement aux premières heures du jour, maintenir ensuite les fenêtres fermées.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Plutôt que d'acheter un tel appareil, des mesures simples peuvent être prises pour passer les périodes de fortes chaleurs en gardant la tête froide: "}, {"side": "en", "quote": "Ventilators are relatively inexpensive and consume less energy than air conditioning units, and they keep the air flowing and thus help cool the room.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Ventilators are relatively inexpensive and consume less energy than air conditioning units, and they keep the air flowing and thus help cool the room."}]}
